instruction: Please move the text box to the top edge of the canvas. I need it positioned at the very top.

metadata.explanation: This variation asks the user to move the text box to the top of the image. The evaluator checks if the topmost dark pixel is within the top 5% of the image height. Similar difficulty to original, just vertical movement.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to move text box to the top edge of canvas
Postconfig properly exports GIMP canvas to PNG using Shift+Ctrl+E and saves with correct filename
Getter (get_vm_file) successfully fetches the exported image file from VM to local cache
Metric correctly implements verification logic: loads image, converts to grayscale, scans for topmost dark pixel (text)
Top 3% threshold is appropriate for 'very top' positioning requirement (updated from previous 5%)
Data flow is semantically correct: vm_file path -> result_state parameter -> Image.open(result_state)
Metric properly handles edge cases: None result_state, no dark pixels found, exceptions all return 0.0
Complete coverage: all instruction requirements verified (single requirement: position at top)
Static validator warnings about 'may not consume vm_file' are false positives - metric correctly uses result_state as file path at line 29
